patterns.note: The hero section features a centered, minimalist text block with two call-to-action buttons, set against a full-bleed, subtly animated background.
Main headings use a distinctive pixelated, glitch-style serif font, contrasting with clean, modern sans-serif for body text, subheadings, and navigation.
A high-contrast black and white palette dominates the site, with black text and buttons on a pristine white background, allowing the abstract hero visuals to provide subtle color accents.
The hero background features blurred, abstract images that parallax upwards at a different rate than the foreground text as the user scrolls, eventually revealing a central animated 3D art piece.
Product features are presented in a two-column grid layout, each with a concise description and a dedicated call-to-action button, maintaining a clean and spacious aesthetic.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a layered approach where a full-bleed background image or video element scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect. The main heading uses a custom font that renders with a pixelated or 'glitch' aesthetic. A central animated 3D art piece is revealed as the user scrolls past the initial hero text, acting as a dynamic focal point.

Scroll-triggered reveals are used to introduce content sections below the hero, where elements appear with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement without being overly distracting.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, distinctive pixelated headings (~3x body) with clean, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase button labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all interactive elements like buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero section, transitioning to a balanced density for feature grids and footer content, maintaining clear separation between elements.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold use of a pixelated, glitch-style font for primary headings, which immediately signals a connection to digital art and web3. This is powerfully combined with an abstract, animated 3D video hero and a clean, high-contrast black and white aesthetic, creating a unique blend of retro-digital and modern luxe.
